capabilities.name: Commander Context
capabilities.description: Expose verified repository, deployment, app, and capability context to the Oli runtime.

capabilities.name: Manuscript Runtime
capabilities.description: Compile the governed Oli behavior contract and app overlay into runtime instructions.

capabilities.name: First-line Product Support
capabilities.description: Route routine navigation, product, subscription, privacy, feedback, and support intents using verified local context.

capabilities.name: App Navigation
capabilities.description: Navigate users to app screens once each app registers its navigation map.

capabilities.name: Current Web Research
capabilities.description: Use a server-side approved research provider when current external information materially matters.

capabilities.name: Generative AI Provider
capabilities.description: Route complex natural-language work to an approved server-side model provider through a replaceable adapter.
capabilities.dependency: approved provider, credentials, model, budget, privacy configuration

capabilities.name: Feedback Capture
capabilities.description: Capture structured bug, feature, content, assistant, billing, and other feedback into the approved destination.
capabilities.dependency: feedback storage destination and consent rules

capabilities.name: Subscription and Entitlement Explanation
capabilities.description: Explain current plan and entitlement state without inventing prices or access.

capabilities.name: Agent Handoff
capabilities.description: Create structured handoff packets for authorized human or AI specialists while preserving provenance and permission scope.

capabilities.name: Approved Design Library
capabilities.description: Reference approved AllPath/SynchPathways design source material without automatically redesigning locked assets.
capabilities.dependency: app design profile and accessible source asset

capabilities.name: Repository Read
capabilities.description: Read authorized source repositories through the connected GitHub app/session.

capabilities.name: Repository Write
capabilities.description: Create reviewable branches, commits, and pull requests when the active task authorizes a write.
capabilities.dependency: GitHub contents/pull-request permission and task authorization

capabilities.name: Deployment Observation
capabilities.description: Read current Vercel project/deployment state for the verified team.

capabilities.name: Deployment Change
capabilities.description: Production deployment mutations stay blocked until the task explicitly authorizes the target and deployment action.
capabilities.dependency: explicit deployment authorization and verified target

capabilities.name: Cross-app Private Data Sharing
capabilities.description: Private data is never shared across apps merely because both apps use Oli.
capabilities.dependency: explicit lawful/consensual sharing basis and app-specific permission

capabilities.name: Foundation Model Weight Retraining
capabilities.description: The Oli hub does not silently modify third-party model weights. Operational learning occurs through versioned prompts, retrieval, registries, tests, and approved feedback loops.
